United Parcel Service (UPS) Stake Maintained by Sabal Trust Co; Oakworth Capital Has Decreased Its Position in Apple Common (AAPL) as Stock Value Rose
May 30, 2018 - By Ash
Sabal Trust Co increased its stake in United Parcel Service Inc (UPS) by 8.15% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sabal Trust Co bought 18,672 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.87% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 247,856 shares of the transportation company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $25.94M, up from 229,184 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sabal Trust Co who had been investing in United Parcel Service Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $99.09B market cap company. The stock increased 1.03% or $1.17 during the last trading session, reaching $115. About 556,563 shares traded. United Parcel Service, Inc. (NYSE:UPS) has risen 9.01% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.56% the S&P500.
Oakworth Capital Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc. Common (AAPL) by 3.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oakworth Capital Inc sold 2,755 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 71,337 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $11.79 million, down from 74,092 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oakworth Capital Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc. Common for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $920.07B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.71 during the last trading session, reaching $187.19. About 5.68 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Sabal Trust Co, which manages about $1.05 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Boeing Co (NYSE:BA) by 19,586 shares to 88,593 shares, valued at $29.05M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Hanesbrands Inc (NYSE:HBI) by 983,240 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 23,933 shares, and cut its stake in Abbvie Inc (NYSE:ABBV).
